results.content: # Plant Wealth of India (भारत की वनस्पति सम्पदा) | Pithecellobium dulce (Hindi -Singri /Vilayati babul /Vilayati imli /Jangle jalebi /Ganga imli, Sanskrit -Kodukkaapuli, Bengali -Dekhani babul /Jilapi,... What are the medicinal properties of the pithecellobium dulce tree? It is a small to medium sized, evergreen, spiny tree, growing upto 18 m in height and is cultivated throughout the plains of India. Oil extracted from the seeds is used in soap making and for cooking. Leaves are also used for the treatment of leprosy, intestinal disorders, peptic ulcer, earache and toothaches. Fruits are consumed as a food in many parts of India due to its sweet taste and nutrition property. Seed extract is used in the treatment of diabetes. The fruit peel has been used for the control of diabetes by the local people of the Northwestern region of Tamilnadu. In Haiti, root and bark decoctions are taken in diarrhoea and in Guiana, root bark is used in dysentery and as fabrifuge.
